name: IMAGO Connector
author: IMAGO

sections.description:
IMAGO Connector is the official plugin of the IMAGO image agency. It lets you search the IMAGO archive of news, sports and stock images, and add images to your Media Library, without leaving WordPress.

Features

  • IMAGO tab in the media window: search and import directly from the block editor, the classic editor, the featured image dialog and page builders that use the WordPress Media Library.
  • Import from IMAGO page under Media, with a full-screen search.
  • Search by keyword or IMAGO picture ID, in all images or in stock or sports images only. Results load as you scroll, and images that are already in your Media Library are marked, so nothing is imported twice.
  • Import options for each image: file name, download size, and an optional maximum size, to save storage space.
  • Automatic credits: IMAGO images are credited below the image on your site, for example “Photo: IMAGO/Sven Simon”. The credit links to the image on imago-images.com, or on imago-images.de on German-language sites. The prefix can be customised.
  • Credit preview in the block editor: see the credit below each IMAGO image while you write, and edit the photographer credit in the block settings.
  • Credit enforcement (optional): IMAGO images without a photographer credit are replaced by a “credit missing” placeholder on your site until the credit is added.
  • Recognises IMAGO files you upload yourself: images downloaded from imago-images.com are identified by their embedded metadata and credited automatically.
  • Translated into German (informal and formal), French, Dutch and Italian. The default credit prefix “Photo:” follows your site’s language, for example “Foto:” on German sites.

Requirements

You need an IMAGO account with API access. To request API credentials, please contact IMAGO.

External services

This plugin connects to the IMAGO API (https://api.imago-images.com), operated by IMAGO, to search the IMAGO archive and download images. Without this service, the plugin cannot search or import images.

  • When you search in the IMAGO tab or on the Import from IMAGO page, your search terms, the requested page of results and your IMAGO API credentials are sent to the IMAGO API.
  • When you import an image, the picture ID, the requested size and your API credentials are sent, and the image file is downloaded to your site.
  • When you click Test connection in the settings, your API credentials are sent to check that they are valid.
  • Preview images in the search results are loaded by your browser directly from api.imago-images.com.
  • When an uploaded image is recognised as an IMAGO image and its archive cannot be read from the file, the picture ID is sent to the IMAGO API to look it up.

Requests to the IMAGO API are made only by logged-in users who can upload files, or by administrators for the connection test. No data is sent when visitors view your site.

sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin from Plugins › Add New, or upload the plugin zip there with Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Go to Settings › IMAGO, enter your IMAGO API user and API key, and click Test connection.
  4. Open any media window and select the IMAGO tab, or go to Media › Import from IMAGO.
sections.faq:
How do I get an API key?

Please contact IMAGO to request API access for your account.

Where does the photographer credit come from?

When an image is imported, the credit is taken from the image’s metadata and stored in the image’s Description field in the Media Library. You can change it there, or in the IMAGO panel of the block settings in the editor.

Where are credits shown?

Below Image blocks (including images in galleries) and below Featured Image blocks in block themes. In the classic editor, the credit is added to the caption when you insert an image.

Credits are added when a page is displayed, so if you change a credit or a setting, every post using that image is updated.

Can I change the format of the credit?

Yes. Under Settings › IMAGO › Credits, you can change the prefix. The default “Photo:” is shown in your site’s language (for example “Foto:” on German sites); any other text is shown as entered. The credit always links to the image on IMAGO.

My theme does not use blocks. How do I show the credit for featured images?

Use the [imago_credit] shortcode, which shows the credit of the current post’s featured image, or [imago_credit id="123"] for a specific image. Theme developers can use imago_connector_get_credit( $attachment_id ) in templates.

Does it work with page builders?

Yes, if the page builder uses the WordPress Media Library to select images. Credits are added automatically for Image blocks; for other elements, use the [imago_credit] shortcode.

I used the previous “Imago Images” plugin. What happens to my images?

Your settings are taken over automatically, and images imported with the previous plugin keep their link to IMAGO and continue to be credited. Please deactivate and delete the previous plugin after activating IMAGO Connector. While both are active, IMAGO Connector pauses itself to avoid duplicate credits.

Where is the source code of the JavaScript?

The scripts in the build/ folder are compiled. Their human-readable source is included in the plugin, in the src/ folder. To build them yourself, run npm install and then npm run build in the plugin folder; the build tool, @wordpress/scripts, is listed in package.json.

1.1.4

First release of IMAGO Connector. If you use the previous “Imago Images” plugin, your settings and images are taken over automatically.
